title: Should Investors Buy CoreWeave Stock Instead of Nebius Stock? | CRWV STock vs. NBIS STock
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc compares two beaten-down neocloud names head to head, CoreWeave and Nebius, on growth, balance sheet and valuation, and stresses that both suit high-risk-tolerance investors only. CoreWeave's trailing revenue is $7.6 billion, up from about $1.5 billion, with analyst estimates of $13 billion in 2026 rising roughly three to four times to about $43 billion in later years, backed by a backlog in the billions that needs more data-centre capacity to serve. His DCF for CoreWeave is $83.50 against a $55 current price, about 52% upside. Nebius is forecast to grow revenue from $3.3 billion this year to $22.9 billion in later years; his DCF is $248 against $160, about 55% upside, on a forward price/sales of 3.5. The decisive difference, he argues, is the balance sheet: Nebius holds $10 billion of long-term debt and over $8 billion of cash and short-term investments, while CoreWeave carries over $51 billion of debt with little cash. Demand should exceed supply through 2027 for both, but he warns of a possible industry glut from 2029 to 2032 after trillions of build-out, with debt-funded assets exposed if pricing falls. The calls are CRWV — BUY reiterated and NBIS — BUY reiterated. The caption file ends mid-sentence, so the name of his final pick drops out and no winner is recorded.
